auto_tag:
Magic Context adds a tag such as §12§ to many user messages, texts you write and tool results. Some items have no tag. Use only numbers you can see; never guess or infer a missing one. IMPORTANT: Tags are added for you. NEVER write tag notation in a reply or in tool arguments. To refer to an item in your prose, write "tag 12".

Examples: if an output shows §12§, refer to it in prose as "tag 12" and stamp it with `ctx_reduce(drop="12")` once used. If an item has no tag, leave it unstamped. Write replies normally, for example "Reading both files in parallel.", without adding a tag.
